name: signal-migration-app
description: Moves a user's data from Telegram into Signal, in the browser.

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../crates/signal-wasm && cargo build --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir ../../app/src/wasm target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/signal_migration_wasm.wasm && cd ../../app && wasm-opt -Oz --strip-debug --strip-producers src/wasm/signal_migration_wasm_bg.wasm -o src/wasm/signal_migration_wasm_bg.wasm
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:attestation && node build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run generate && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:attestation && tsc --noEmit
scripts.format: prettier --write . && (cd ../crates/server && cargo fmt) && (cd ../crates/signal-wasm && cargo fmt) && (cd ../crates/attestation-wasm && cargo fmt)
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && (cd ../crates/server && cargo fmt --check) && (cd ../crates/signal-wasm && cargo fmt --check) && (cd ../crates/attestation-wasm && cargo fmt --check)
scripts.prepare: if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then git config core.hooksPath .githooks; fi
